scope: All 86 vanilla and 106 audited mod-container source entries; 173 active exact IDs. Optional source mods are not bundled or made mandatory. Portable item additions are recorded in portableExpansion.
sourceAudit: Original 187 entries retain Build 42.21 source audits from 2026-10-21. Four wearable additions were checked against installed source definitions on 2026-11-01. Portable source identifiers and source-file SHA-256 values are retained; raw machine-local audit artifacts are not distributed. The optional single-hand freshness lunchbox was checked against its independent 0.1.0-rc.3 candidate source definition on 2026-11-06; source defaults, food filter, size restriction and absence of wearable slots are bound below.
validationStatus: Build 42.21 single-player unpublished v1.0.3 candidate. v1.0.0 representative gameplay was previously confirmed; four v1.0.1 wearable integrations and the v1.0.3 freshness lunchbox require separate user gameplay acceptance. Offline checks do not claim 173 individually tested items. Multiplayer is not validated.
